extracted.notes:
The nine-time Tony-winning musical from the creators of South Park and the Oscar-winning composer of Frozen, about two mismatched missionaries.

Winner of 9 Tony Awards including Best Musical! Two idealistic young missionaries are sent on a wild, irreverent adventure to Uganda. Direction and choreography by Casey Nicholaw.

Original cast members Rory O'Malley (Tony nominee) and Nikki M. James (Tony winner) return from October 27 to January 17 only.

## Know before you go

- Run time: 2hr 30min, incl. 15min intermission
- Ages 13+. Children under 4 will not be admitted.
- Tickets start at $72.
